review.why: Builds design token systems (primitive, semantic, component), component specs, Tailwind integration and strategic slides, with generator and validator scripts.
review.summary: Explains a three-layer token architecture with a short example, then points to references for primitive, semantic and component tokens, states and variants, component specs and Tailwind integration. Quick start commands generate tokens from a config and validate usage in a source folder. Slide generation uses searchable strategy, layout, color and copy data files.
strengths: Three-layer token model with an example
Validator checks that code actually uses the tokens
Slide strategy data is searchable and token-aware
cautions: Seven references, many data files and scripts are not read here
Needs Node and Python for the helpers
Slide generation depends on bundled data
